title: Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool: INT8 vs FP8 model
note: Sixteen consecutive upscaled frames from a recorded clip of the Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool, 4K Balanced (render 2228x1256), the area where the two models differ most (46.5 dB apart, the largest gap of the 12 game clips). Upscaler output only: no UI or post-processing. FP8 emulated through Proton's FP16 WMMA path on an RX 7800 XT. Display mapping x/(1+x), gamma 1/2.2 (not a game's tone mapping).
